content: Ciprofloxacin oral suspension is available in two concentrations: 5% (5 grams of ciprofloxacin in 100 mL) and 10% (10 grams of ciprofloxacin in 100 mL). The medication consists of two separate components: microcapsules and a diluent, which must be combined before dispensing. One teaspoon (5 mL) of the 5% ciprofloxacin oral suspension contains 250 mg of ciprofloxacin. Similarly, one teaspoon (5 mL) of the 10% ciprofloxacin oral suspension contains 500 mg of ciprofloxacin. Preparation of the Suspension: 1. The smaller bottle contains the microcapsules, while the larger bottle contains the diluent. 2. Open both bottles. For the child-proof cap, press down as instructed on the cap while turning it to the left. 3. Pour the entire contents of the microcapsule bottle into the larger bottle containing the diluent. Do not add water to the suspension. 4. Remove the top layer of the diluent bottle’s label to reveal the CIPRO Oral Suspension label. Close the larger bottle securely as per the instructions on the cap and shake it vigorously for approximately 15 seconds. The suspension is now ready for use. 5. No additional substances should be added to the prepared ciprofloxacin suspension. CIPRO Oral Suspension must not be administered through feeding tubes or nasogastric (NG) tubes due to its physical properties. Instructions for the Patient: Shake the CIPRO Oral Suspension vigorously for about 15 seconds before each use. Always use the provided graduated measuring spoon to ensure accurate dosing. Do not chew the microcapsules; they should be swallowed whole. Water may be consumed after taking the medication. Properly reclose the bottle after each use, following the instructions on the cap. Once the treatment course is completed, any remaining CIPRO Oral Suspension should not be reused.
